title: Auditory Profile and Language Development in Children Operated for Cleft Palate
brief_summary: Observational study about children with cleft palate from surgery to pre-adolescence :Description of language development and hearing profile.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children aged 5 to 11 years old operated on for a veloplasty at the Robert Debré Hospital
* operated between 2008 and 2014
* having a cleft veil with or without a cleft lip and palate

Exclusion Criteria:

* Children operated on for primary veloplasty outside the Robert Debré Hospital, and coming for secondary veloplasty.

Child operated on for a veloplasty for a cause other than the velar cleft.
study_population: Children with a cleft vein operated on for a veloplasty at Robert Debré Hospital
